title: Allahabad High Court orders security for 3 lawyers after they face violence in Lucknow court
description: The Allahabad Court on Tuesday ordered Lucknow Police to provide security to at least three advocates, including two women lawyers, who alleged harassment and violence by certain advocates of the Lucknow district court.A Division Bench of Justice Rajan Roy and Justice Manjive Shukla took up the matter at 7 pm in the evening after the counsel, who mainly practice in Delhi, moved an application alleging that advocate Saurabh Kumar Verma along with his associates prevented them from appearing befor
